    ESOL Scholar SocietyTogether, We Speak Success

    English Practice Room is a free practice tool made by the ESOL Scholar Society. It is independent and is not an official WIDA product, and WIDA did not make, check, or approve it. All passages, scripts, questions, and prompts are original. Results are practice numbers, not official scores or proficiency levels. Translations are drafts that need review by native speakers.
